manner: A small female house sparrow, not a humanoid: the Sheet type has no animal body yet, so the Studio must add one (as for B02's wheelchair). Read the colours as: skin = back and wings, warm brown with darker streaks; hair = the crown; top = the pale breast; bottom = the tail; shoes = the pink legs. She hops with both feet together and never walks; fluffs into a round ball when she is cold; tilts her head to look at things with one eye.

Sits on a low stool behind his stall and knits without looking at his hands; hums while he works; trims the loose ends of his wool with small scissors and lets the bits fall; waves his needles instead of his hand.
